patterns.note: Sparse, single-column layout with abundant negative space, especially in the hero section, creating a minimalist and focused presentation.
Dominant use of extremely large, ultra-thin sans-serif typography for headings and list items, making text a primary visual and atmospheric element.
A stark monochromatic palette of black and white is dramatically accented by a single, vibrant, glowing yellow-green graphic.
The logo in the header shrinks and sticks to the top-left corner upon scrolling, while a large, glowing circular graphic in the background parallaxes, moving slower than the foreground content.
A distinct hero section featuring oversized branding and a prominent graphic, followed by a long, scrollable list of content items presented with large, repeating typography.

technique_notes: The header logo implements a sticky behavior, transforming its size to a smaller scale as the user scrolls down the page.
A large, luminous background graphic employs a parallax scrolling effect, creating a sense of depth by moving at a slower rate than the foreground content.

Content sections, specifically the list of names, are revealed progressively as the user scrolls into view, likely facilitated by the locomotive-scroll library for a smooth and controlled scroll experience.

design_tokens.type_scale: Extremely oversized, thin hero headings (~5-6x body text) with small, regular-weight body text. List items also use very large, thin typography.
design_tokens.spacing: Very airy in the hero section, transitioning to a denser layout with large text elements in the content list sections.

standout: The site's standout feature is its bold, almost abstract minimalism, using a single, large, glowing graphic and oversized, ultra-thin typography as the primary visual and informational elements. This creates a unique, atmospheric brand presence that prioritizes visual impact and mood over conventional content density.
